title: Coefficient extension, continuous derivatives and the colon-minor Jacobian ideal of restricted series
statement:
Let $K$ be a real-valued nonarchimedean normed field and let $r,s\geq0$. Write $A_K=K\langle x_1,\ldots,x_rangle$ for the restricted-series subring of [def-trf-restricted-series-presentation]. For an isometric field embedding $\phi:K	o L$, coefficient extension sends $\sum_
u a_
u x^
u$ to $\sum_
u\phi(a_
u)x^
u$; it preserves restrictedness and defines a ring homomorphism $A_K	o A_L$. The termwise derivative $\partial_i$ has coefficient $(
u_i+1)a_{
u+e_i}$ at $
u$ and preserves restrictedness, defining $\partial_i:A_K	o A_K$. Given $f_1,\ldots,f_s\in A_K$, define $I=(f_1,\ldots,f_s)$, $C=A_K/I$, and for $E\subseteq\{1,\ldots,s\}$ put $I_E=(f_j:j\in E)$. For $T\subseteq\{1,\ldots,r\}$ with $|T|=|E|$, order both sets increasingly and put $D_{E,T}=\det(\partial_i f_j)_{i\in T,j\in E}$ using [def-weil-pbc-matrix-determinant]. The continuous Jacobian ideal is $H(f)=\sum_{E,T}\overline{(I_E:I)}\,\overline{D_{E,T}}C$, where $(I_E:I)=\{a:aI\subseteq I_E\}$ and the bar is the quotient map. Empty subsets and the zero quotient are allowed; the empty determinant is one and $I_\varnothing=0$.

reviewed_lean.note: Item statement and proof are unchanged from base; the only stmt_deps change adds the new §1(A) node def-per-restricted-series-jacobian. Every clause checked against Mathlib: IsRestricted.subring with radius 1 = coefficients tend to zero; map = restriction of MvPowerSeries.map φ along an isometry; pderiv = termwise MvPowerSeries.pderiv; jacobianMinor = Matrix.det with rows T and columns E, both increasing; colon = Submodule.colon (aI ⊆ I_E); jacobianIdeal = ⨆ over |T|=|E| of the image of the colon ideal times the span of the minor's image; conclusion = ⊤. The L universe max u v only weakens the hypothesis and includes K's universe. Edge cases covered: s=0, r=0, C=0, E=T=∅, characteristic p. The new def node has real data and no choices; its two typing theorems are true and sorried with docstrings; no duplicate found by rg over lean/ or in Mathlib. Recorded statements are verbatim; docstrings and source places are present. No file changed, so nothing compiled. Note: the Second reading section is the author's own pass, not independent.
